title.value: AICOM-MP: AN AI- BASED MONKEYPOX DETECTOR FOR RESOURCE-CONSTRAINED ENVIRONMENTS
title.justification: The paper focuses on the development and deployment of an AI-based monkeypox detection system, addressing technology constraints in resource-limited settings.
title.quote: AICOM-MP: AN AI- BASED MONKEYPOX DETECTOR FOR RESOURCE-CONSTRAINED ENVIRONMENTS

extractions.description: The paper introduces AICOM-MP, an AI-based system developed to detect monkeypox in resource-constrained environments. It aims to provide disease screening accessible via web services and mobile devices, targeting areas with limited healthcare capabilities. The solution is built into Autonomous Mobile Clinics (AMCs) designed to enhance global health coverage, especially in Least Developed Countries (LDCs).

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper highlights addressing health resource limitations in LDCs as part of the broader goal of enhancing health care access, aligning with SDG3.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Particularly, AMCs answer to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 3 (SDG3) on health, which represents a universal recognition that health is fundamental to human capital and social and economic development.

primary_category.justification: The focus on deploying AI and mobile health clinics to enhance healthcare access in Least Developed Countries aligns with efforts to support the Global South.
primary_category.quote: Under the Autonomous Mobile Clinics (AMCs) initiative, we are developing, open sourcing, and standardizing health AI technologies to enable healthcare access in least developed countries (LDCs).

secondary_categories.justification: The paper indirectly deals with adaptation by enhancing healthcare delivery systems to cope with diseases that could be impacted by climate change, such as monkeypox.
secondary_categories.quote: Under the AMCs initiative and facing the recent global monkeypox outbreak, in this article we introduce AICOM-MP, an AI-based monkeypox detector that has achieved SOTA performance

primary_sub_category.justification: The development and standardization of AI technologies and offering open-source datasets and methodologies for healthcare improvement imply a focus on knowledge sharing.
primary_sub_category.quote: We have also open sourced both the source code and the dataset of AICOM-MP to allow health AI professionals to integrate AICOM-MP into their services.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The technology assists in managing disease outbreaks efficiently and can improve access to health services during crisis times, aligning with relief efforts.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Under the AMCs initiative and facing the recent global monkeypox outbreak, in this article we introduce AICOM-MP, an AI-based monkeypox detector that has achieved SOTA performance

applications.justification: The primary application discussed in the paper is using AI to detect monkeypox efficiently in areas with limited resources.
applications.quote: Compared to existing AI-based monkeypox detectors, AICOM-MP has achieved state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance.

applications.justification: The application of deploying AICOM-MP in AMCs for improved healthcare access is emphasized.
applications.quote: autonomous mobile clinics are self-driving vehicles equipped with medical diagnostic equipment, telemedicine capability and an artificial intelligence (AI) software.

new_primary_category.justification: The existing categories sufficiently cover the focus of the paper.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The existing sub-categories adequately describe the specifics of the paper's contents.
